verdicts.reason: Fragments only show full mb/smp_mb, smp_cond_load_acquire, and READ/WRITE_ONCE; read, write, DMA, virt, pmem, and IO ordering barriers are not in the cited fragments.
Futex teardown is not shown, and futex_hash_allocate_default can reallocate if thread count grows (not 'publishes once'). Lockdep, futex init/sizing, and rwsem parts hold.
The fragments show atomic instrumented wrappers only call kcsan_mb() and instrument_*_read/write helpers before delegating to raw_atomic_* functions, adding no locking.
Plain and killable mutex forms are not shown in fragments, and bit_spin_unlock only validates the bit is held when CONFIG_DEBUG_SPINLOCK is enabled.

overall: Finding 3 is fully supported; Findings 1, 2, and 4 are partial due to uncited barrier/mutex variants, missing futex teardown, repeatable hash allocation, and debug-only bitlock checks.
